goal: Compose existing identity providers, Security authorization semantics, Gateway enforcement/routing, and natural owners without creating a new identity or policy platform.
invariants: Principal != Agent != Grant != Effect != provider/resource identity.
Gateway does not own OAuth, credential material, Security policy semantics, or owner truth.
Interactive admission and workload admission are distinct profiles.
Human/browser presentation is not required for ordinary workload admission.
External bearer tokens are not generic downstream Ordivon credentials.
DCR is compatibility only; client registration mechanism is replaceable.
Network route selection is orthogonal to identity/authorization semantics.

nodes.responsibility: Freeze Admission Fabric architecture boundary and anti-growth laws.
Compile workload H3 circuit without browser/Human dependency.
Reuse existing Principal/Agent/Grant/Effect admission semantics and OPA decisions.
Enforce one Security-owned capability decision before owner routing.
Supply trusted Agent + Grant evidence for the selected Gateway capability.
Select one real workload identity provider only when an unattended consumer requires it.
Verify current MCP 2026-07-28 wire surface independently from admission semantics.
Re-run H2 interactive live witness with transaction-isolated callback.
Re-run pinned OPA OCI policy test when Docker registry path is healthy.

nextSlice.target: Choose one low-risk read capability, establish trusted Agent/Grant evidence, evaluate through existing Security contract, and enforce the decision at Gateway.
acceptance: Unauthenticated caller cannot reach the capability.
Authenticated Principal without a matching Grant is DENY, not implicit ALLOW.
Matching verified Agent/Grant can ALLOW the exact capability only.
Changed capability/resource cannot reuse the same authority projection.
Gateway does not persist credentials or redefine Security decision semantics.
Owner receives no external bearer token passthrough.
Existing direct-owner admin/recovery paths remain separate.
